MathJax 3.2.2 (es5 build), Apache License 2.0, see LICENSE.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz
npm dist.integrity: sha512-Bt+SSVU8eBG27zChVewOicYs7Xsdt40qm4+UpHyX7k0/O9NliPc+x77k1/FEsPsjKPZGJvtRZM1vO+geW0OhGw==
The release archive was checked against npm dist.integrity before copying.

Included upstream resources:
- tex-chtml.js (bundles TeX, CHTML, TeX fonts, menu, assistive MathML).
- a11y/ (semantic enrichment, complexity, explorer, speech engine).
- input/tex/extensions/ (all upstream TeX extension components).
- input/mml.js and input/mml/ (MathML input, entities, MML3 extension).
- output/chtml/fonts/woff-v2/ (all upstream CHTML font files).
- output/svg.js and output/svg/ (SVG renderer and TeX glyph data).
- sre/mathmaps/ (all upstream speech locales, base rules and Nemeth).

This subset supports the CHTML default, both renderer choices and the
accessibility options exposed by the built-in MathJax context menu.
Only the initial CHTML bundle and fonts load for normal reading; other
components and speech maps load on demand from the same site.
Upstream code and JSON data are unchanged. Repository line endings and
insignificant trailing whitespace in speech JSON files are normalized.
